description: Traffic signal poles and stop signs at junctions (render-only). heading: compass bearing (radians clockwise from north) the head or sign faces, toward the approaching traffic. group: signal phase group (0/1, one per axis). arm: mast-arm length over the lanes (m, 0 = none). ped: bearing of the pedestrian head, or null. allWay: every approach into the node is stop-controlled.
attribution: Junction paint, signals, stop signs and street signs: placed by pipeline/build-street-detail.ts from the road graph (DataSF 3psu-pn9h) and traffic signals (SFMTA ybh5-27n2). Continental Crosswalks: SFMTA via DataSF (g9zy-srvv); Stop Signs: SFMTA via DataSF (4542-gpa3); Street Signs: SFMTA via DataSF (m48z-6ji4), ODC PDDL 1.0.
